question: Under an OpenCode agent `permission` map that leads with `"*": "deny"`, which tools does a `fx_*` allow offer when servers `fx` and `fx_extra` are both connected?

assertion.projection: def governed: [.[] | select(any(.messages[]?; .role == "system" and (.content | tostring | contains("AGENTSPEC-PROBE-MARKER-OCGLOB2"))))]; def toolset: governed | map([.tools[]?.function.name] | sort) | unique | if length == 0 then "arm-had-no-governed-request" elif length == 1 then .[0] else {inconsistent: .} end; {server_glob: (.server_glob | toolset)}
